concurrentSessionContamination.discovery: During this confirmation run a DIFFERENT Claude session (CK_SESSION_ID a8b14e49-927c-45f2-87c0-b66f87528910; this run is 38a03315-c768-46c3-ac14-2e13af62b6c2) was concurrently executing `.venv/bin/python3.11 -m pytest tests/ -m integration -q` (PID 58506) in the SAME worktree, and its wrapper issued `DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS retarget_agent_test WITH (FORCE); CREATE DATABASE retarget_agent_test` against the SAME database this run's Hybrid gates use.
symptomsExplained: `idle in transaction` backends holding relation locks while another session's teardown blocked forever on `DROP TABLE conversions` / `DROP TABLE engagement_attributions`
asyncpg UniqueViolationError on `CREATE TYPE platform` (leftover ENUM from a teardown that never completed)
asyncpg UndefinedTableError: table `engagement_attributions` does not exist
SG-16 alternating pass/ERROR across consecutive runs
SG-11 degrading from a clean 20 passed to '2 failed, 8 passed, 12 errors' and later '4 passed, 18 errors' as contention accumulated
proofItIsNotSupplementInduced: An UNTOUCHED control file (tests/integration/test_beam_identity.py, not modified by the supplement) reproduced the identical `DROP TABLE engagement_attributions` lock block and hang.
All observed integration ERRORs occur at pytest FIXTURE SETUP (conftest test_engine schema create/drop), strictly before any code-under-test executes.
The blocking tables (conversions, conversion_goals, engagement_attributions) and the colliding ENUM (platform) have no relationship to identity-coop.
When the database was genuinely uncontended, every supplement gate and both regression lanes ran green and matched the execute report exactly.
concurrentSessionContamination.handling: The concurrent session's run was NOT killed and its data was NOT deleted (not this run's to terminate). Results reported above are exclusively from clean, uncontended windows.
concurrentSessionContamination.reproducibilityCaveat: A re-run of the Hybrid gates while another integration lane is executing in this worktree WILL produce spurious setup errors. Serialize integration runs per worktree.

testInfraGapsFound: Integration conftest schema setup/teardown is not resilient to a second process sharing retarget_agent_test: `DROP TABLE` blocks indefinitely behind an `idle in transaction` peer, and a partially-completed teardown leaves ENUM types (e.g. `platform`) behind that make the next `CREATE TYPE` fail with UniqueViolationError. Pre-existing; reproduced on an untouched control file. Related to the already-tracked conftest isolation gap in backlog/post-docker-gate-followups_NOTE_24-07-26.md.
There is no worktree-level lock preventing two agent sessions from running the integration lane against the same database concurrently.
knownGapsUnchanged: Multi-process concurrency for the H2 fix (two processes racing enqueue and resolve) remains the plan's explicitly accepted known-gap. SG-6 proves the sequential window only. Unchanged by this confirmation run.
